## Context / Problem
Cites are on origin/main 083620b0. `src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py` is a whole-file re-export of `rebar._ids` (docstring `:8`). `src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py:18-31` re-exports 7 names from `_processors_identity`/`_processors_status` marked `# noqa: F401 (re-exported for back-compat)`: `_rederive_keyring_keys`, `process_key_event`, `process_signature`, `_fold_claimed_session`, `_fold_close_metadata`, `_fold_plan_review_phase`, `process_status`. ADR 0111 (`docs/adr/0111-no-internal-only-compatibility-shims.md:40-57`) forbids internal-only shims and requires atomic migration of source, test, string, dynamic-import and monkeypatch targets. This story touches import and prose lines only; landing it first means every other epic rebases over one-line import diffs.

## Approach
One change: rewrite every importer to the canonical module, delete the resolver shim and the seven re-export lines, fix the monkeypatch string and the one shim-asserting test. Population found by Serena `find_referencing_symbols` on `resolve_ticket_id` plus `git grep` for the module strings; the lists below are the whole population.

Resolver: the 58 single-line `from rebar._engine_support.resolver import X` sites in 43 files (itemised in the first comment) become `from rebar._ids import X`. Module-object form: `tests/unit/commands/test_replacement_walker.py:46` and `tests/unit/test_close_precheck_duplicate_link_c8fd.py:59` (`from rebar._engine_support import resolver as _resolver` becomes `from rebar import _ids as _resolver`); `tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py:397`, which has NO alias and is consumed as the bare name `resolver` by `monkeypatch.setattr(resolver, ...)` at `:409`, becomes `from rebar import _ids as resolver`; `tests/unit/test_close_duration_instrumentation.py:27-31`, a MULTI-LINE `from rebar._engine_support import (commit_impact, descendants, resolver,)` consumed by `monkeypatch.setattr(resolver, ...)` at `:258,259,464`, drops `resolver` from the tuple and adds `from rebar import _ids as resolver` (the AC greps for a bare `resolver,` line). Attribute form `rebar._engine_support.resolver.resolve_ticket_id(...)` becomes `rebar._ids.resolve_ticket_id(...)` at `tests/unit/{test_compact_sweep_perf.py:75, test_compact_trigger.py:70, test_completion_sidecar_lock_loss_ab54.py:99, test_relocated_store_repo_root.py:240}`. Multi-line functional form: `tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_alias_backfill.py:30-34` (`from rebar._engine_support.resolver import (_resolve_via_binding_store, _scan_alias, resolve_ticket_id,)`, the only such site) becomes `from rebar._ids import (...)` with the same three names. Monkeypatch string `tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py:228` becomes `"rebar._ids.resolve_ticket_dir_name"`. Prose at `docs/bash-migration.md:168`, `src/rebar/_alias.py:4,36`, `src/rebar/_ids.py:23`, `tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_alias_backfill.py:7,119` names `rebar._ids`. Delete `src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py`.

Processors: in `_processors.py` delete lines 21, 23, 24, 27-30 (the seven `noqa` re-exports); keep `_bootstrap_genesis_keyring`, `_fold_author_attribution`, `attestation_kind` (used at `:81,155,213,344,609,627`). Every importer of the seven names is rewritten: `src/rebar/reducer/_replay.py:19-38` currently imports `process_key_event` (`:27`), `process_signature` (`:30`) and `process_status` (`:32`) from `._processors`; split that list so those two come from `._processors_identity` and `process_status` from `._processors_status`, the other fifteen `process_*` names stay on `._processors`. Tests importing `process_status` from the shim (`tests/unit/test_attestations_reducer.py:13-18`, `test_claimed_session.py:20`, `test_harness_provenance.py:20`, `test_plan_review_phase_happy.py:6`, `test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py:10`) take it from `rebar.reducer._processors_status`; those importing `process_signature` (`test_attestations_reducer.py:13-18`, `test_legacy_signature_mirror_drop.py:15`, `test_signing.py:316,332`) take it from `rebar.reducer._processors_identity`; `attestation_kind` and `process_snapshot` stay on `_processors`. `tests/unit/test_processors_status_split.py` holds five tests; the certified test-suite story skaldic-paradoxal-huemul classifies the file DELETE-BUT-MOVE with one behaviour test surviving, and this story performs exactly that move: `test_status_fold_replay_equivalence` (`:77-104`) with its helper `_apply_status` moves into `tests/unit/test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py`, the helper body rewritten to the bare `process_status(...)` that module imports. The other four are deleted deliberately as one-time split guards: `test_moved_names_resolve_from_processors_and_are_object_identical` (`:29-34`) asserts the shim this story removes; `test_process_status_absent_from_reducer_package` (`:37-51`) pins that the moved name is not re-exported from the `rebar.reducer` package, a split-mechanics assertion; `test_split_is_one_way_no_import_of_processors` (`:54-67`) pins import direction; `test_both_modules_under_the_size_target` (`:107-111`) pins a 650-line target the 800-line CI module-size gate already bounds. Then `git rm` the file (a no-op if that story landed first). `_rederive_keyring_keys` and the three `_fold_*` names have no other external importer (`tests/unit/test_administrative_close_dispositions.py:369-384` calls `_processors_status._fold_close_metadata` directly). Importers of names `_processors.py` defines itself stay.

## Scope
The files above and in the first comment: `src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py` (deleted), `tests/unit/test_processors_status_split.py` (deleted), `src/rebar/reducer/{_processors,_replay}.py`, the listed `src/rebar/**` importers, `scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py`, `docs/bash-migration.md`, and the listed `tests/**` files. Out of scope: any behaviour change, any new name, and the bodies of the canonical modules `rebar._ids`, `_processors_identity` and `_processors_status`.

## Testing
- Happy: `git grep -n -E '_engine_support\.resolver|_engine_support import resolver' -- src tests scripts` returns nothing; `python -c "import rebar._engine_support.resolver"` raises `ModuleNotFoundError`.
- Edge: `pytest tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py tests/unit/commands/test_replacement_walker.py tests/unit/test_close_precheck_duplicate_link_c8fd.py tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py tests/unit/test_close_duration_instrumentation.py tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_alias_backfill.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py -q` green (monkeypatch retargeting, the un-aliased and multi-line imports, the moved fold test).
- `ruff check src tests scripts` shows no F401 in `_processors.py`; `pytest tests/unit/test_attestations_reducer.py tests/unit/test_signing.py tests/unit/test_legacy_signature_mirror_drop.py -q` green; `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py` is deleted; `git grep -n -E '_engine_support\.resolver|_engine_support import resolver' -- src tests scripts` and `git grep -n -E '^[[:space:]]*resolver,?[[:space:]]*$' -- tests` both print nothing.
- [ ] `_processors.py` contains no `re-exported for back-compat` line, and `git grep -n -E '^[[:space:]]*from rebar\.reducer\._processors import|^[[:space:]]*from \._processors import' -- src tests` followed by a check of each hit's imported names shows none of `process_status`, `process_signature`, `process_key_event`, `_rederive_keyring_keys`, `_fold_claimed_session`, `_fold_close_metadata`, `_fold_plan_review_phase` (a script over the AST of each hit records the result on this ticket).
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_processors_status_split.py` is gone and `pytest --collect-only -q tests/unit/test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py -k status_fold_replay_equivalence` collects one node.
- [ ] `python -c "import rebar._engine_support.resolver"` raises `ModuleNotFoundError` and the edge-test set above is green under `pytest`.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
